statement: For positive definite diagonal Adam with bias correction, 0<beta1<1 and 0<=beta2<1, if all second moments converge and at least one coordinate has nonzero limiting amplitude, active curvature converges to the frozen threshold; top curvature has a strictly larger limit iff some zero-amplitude coordinate has eta*lambda/epsilon larger than the normalized threshold.
limitations: Does not establish moment convergence or the probability of the active set; novelty not checked against unavailable worker notes.

statement: For fixed positive definite diagonal Hessian and epsilon=eta^p with p<1, eta times both top and active curvature tend uniformly in time and initialization to zero. For p=1 and lambda_max<38 they stay uniformly below 38.
limitations: Elementary consequence of known epsilon cap; not a new settlement of the favorable parameter regimes.
